title: Implement one approved narrowband profile
description:
Implement only the specific narrowband chip/board/backend and profile scope affirmatively approved by narrow.06 and narrow.08. Add the minimum isolated driver/profile support for verified bandwidth, LDRO, framing and profile-derived operation deadlines. Reuse existing driver fixes rather than commissioning a second arbitration or CAD layer.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Affirmative profile, station and security/coding decisions are prerequisites, not blanket hardware capability. Scope one approved platform rather than all radios. This unit performs offline coding/tests only; no physical ports, on-air use or unapproved upstream changes.
acceptance_criteria: Independent vendor-command vectors and narrow.02 timing cases verify exact settings, unsupported-value rejection, long-packet limits and default-off behavior. Baseline profile 0x01 and security remain unchanged. Compile or emulated success is not RF qualification; unresolved approved-scope questions stop implementation.
